subject: disttask: fix flaky summary collection for ingest step (#64471)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focusing on DDL/add-index ingest + dxf metadata/summary behavior. The framework adds `StepExecutor.ResetSummary()` and calls it before starting realtime summary updates (`BaseTaskExecutor.runSubtask`), and `updateSubtaskSummaryLoop` now performs a bounded best-effort final persist with retry/backoff on exit (`pkg/disttask/framework/taskexecutor/task_executor.go`), addressing transient `UpdateSubtaskSummary` failures. DDL ingest-related step executors implement `ResetSummary` and stop resetting summaries inside `RunSubtask` (`pkg/ddl/backfilling_*`), and Lightning local ingest now reports the final partial batch to the collector (`pkg/lightning/backend/local/job_worker.go`), stabilizing RowCnt/Bytes accounting. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, data consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or DDL state/metadata handling; changes are confined to summary collection/persistence and are context-cancel aware. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: subsequent touches are mostly refactors/renames without an obvious semantic follow-up fix to this summary logic.
